topics.title: KY Records Presents ‘Bruce Ritter’s Songs from the Bathhouse'
topics.summary: A KY Records album titled 'Bruce Ritter's Songs from the Bathhouse,' featuring sexually suggestive songs and interviews, is released. The content includes explicit references to young homeless boys, unsettling questions about personal preferences, and interactions with a radio host and his guests; Frank Sinatra discusses Hollywood friends while struggling for memory.

topics.title: Washington Radio Interview - Chaotic Inquiry
topics.summary: During a radio interview in Washington, D.C., the host rapidly shifts topics from basic demographics to bizarre inquiries about Mayor Barry’s reelection chances, Effie's sexuality, and Jewish identity, creating an uncomfortable exchange with callers who offer equally outlandish opinions.

topics.title: Unfiltered Radio Interview – Offensive Questions
topics.summary: A chaotic radio interview descends into a series of bizarre and offensive questions, including inquiries about Jewish people, sexual preferences, and political opinions. The conversation quickly devolves with personal attacks and nonsensical statements, featuring one participant expressing hatred towards Jews while another offers no comment.

topics.title: Belzer's Skin, Rooney Returns & Bucks County Advice
topics.summary: Howard struggles with understanding a colleague while grappling with media fallout and public criticism. The discussion shifts to Andy Rooney’s return to ‘60 Minutes,’ followed by an analysis of ratings losses and advice from Ben Borowski, a local radio personality who cautions against accepting television offers due to potential failure.

topics.title: College Student Calls and Threatening Phone Call
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Howard receives a threatening phone call from an unnamed individual frustrated with his radio career, leading to discussions about listeners like college student Dan discussing his studies and weight concerns while offering self-improvement suggestions. The show then takes calls from other callers including one young man who is struggling in school.

topics.title: Stern Discusses Crime & Threats
topics.summary: During a Howard Stern show segment, hosts discuss recent news including an exorcism involving heavy metal music in New Jersey and a state trooper shot during a drug bust. They then address a disturbing stalker apprehended after sending threatening letters to a woman, highlighting the unsettling nature of his communications.
